fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/CategoryPages/ElectricVehicle.cy.js#CategoryPages - ElectricVehicle [en] — Electric Commercial Vehicles TC-EV-03: Check Truck Price lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Electric Commercial Vehicles
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-EV-03
**Title:** Check Truck Price lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Electric Commercial Vehicles
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the Electric Commercial Vehicles page, open Check Truck Price on a truck card, and submit with name, mobile and city all left empty.

**Expected Result:**
The real, page-shown validation messages for name, mobile and location are displayed, and no lead is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Electric Commercial Vehicles page
2. Click a truck card's "Check Truck Price" button to open its lead form
3. Leave name, mobile and city empty and submit
4. Verify all three required-field validation messages are shown
